name: Invention of Writing
description: Cuneiform emerges in Sumer from accounting tokens, and hieroglyphs appear in Egypt at nearly the same moment — the threshold of recorded history, making law, literature, contracts, and administration durable beyond living memory.

name: Bronze Age Collapse
description: Within decades, nearly every major eastern-Mediterranean civilization — Mycenaean Greece, the Hittite Empire, Ugarit — fell amid raids by the 'Sea Peoples', drought, earthquakes, and systems failure. Writing vanished in Greece for four centuries.
